explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration matching this result. The theorem says: suppose the family t is closed under multiplication and contains 1, the family a mirrors that structure, and every K-linear relation among the t's also holds among the a's. Then there is a K-algebra hom from adjoin K (range t) to L that sends each t i to a i. The proof builds this by hand from Algebra.adjoin_eq_span, Finsupp.linearCombination, Submodule.liftQ, LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange, LinearMap.ext_on_range and AlgHom.ofLinearMap; none of these carries the whole statement. I grepped for exists_algHom_adjoin*, algHom_adjoin_range and of_forall_sum_smul_eq_zero. The only hits were the field-extension lemmas exists_algHom_adjoin_of_splits*, which are unrelated. I know of no Mathlib lemma that extends a linear-relation-preserving map on a multiplicatively closed spanning set to an algebra hom.
